items.name: Extra Regen
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Temporary: sell it later, once you're out of slots.
items.legacy_note: Sell it once you're out of slots.

sections.label: Early game
sections.desc: Souls 0-8,800 (levels 1-15). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Petrifying Bola T1. 4.8k spikes: spirit 4.8k at Cold Front.

items.name: Extra Spirit
items.caption: +10 spirit adds about 27.9 to Lethal Venom's venom max damage (2.79x scaling), your steepest spirit scaling.

items.name: Improved Spirit
items.caption: +18 spirit adds about 50.2 to Lethal Venom's venom max damage (2.79x scaling), your steepest spirit scaling. Upgrade of Extra Spirit (already owned): costs 800 souls more, not 1,600.

items.name: Quicksilver Reload
items.caption: Imbued on Screwjab Dagger: the imbue charges up over 18s; the charged use reloads the clip and gives 10% fire rate for 12s.

items.name: Cold Front
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k spirit tier (3,200 to 4,800 invested): bonus 19 to 38 spirit power.

items.name: Opening Rounds
items.why: weapon investment only; its 4.8k tier completes at Burst Fire, 8000 souls (~8.0 min) later and weapon is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

items.name: Rapid Rounds
items.why: weapon investment only; its 4.8k tier completes at Burst Fire, 7200 souls (~7.2 min) later and weapon is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

items.name: Bullet Lifesteal
items.why: vitality investment only; its 4.8k tier completes at Spirit Lifesteal, 3200 souls (~3.2 min) later and vitality is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

sections.label: Midgame
sections.desc: Souls 8,800-25,600 (levels 15-28). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Screwjab Dagger T3, Slither T3. Your biggest single spirit hit (Lethal Venom, venom max damage) grows from 390 to 522. 4.8k spikes: vitality 4.8k at Spirit Lifesteal, weapon 4.8k at Burst Fire.

items.name: Sprint Boots
items.caption: Builds toward the 4.8k vitality tier, which Spirit Lifesteal completes 2,400 souls on.
items.why: imminent: Spirit Lifesteal completes 4.8k vitality in 2400 souls (~2.4 min), 2 purchases

items.name: Enduring Speed
items.caption: Builds toward the 4.8k vitality tier, which Spirit Lifesteal completes 1,600 souls on. Upgrade of Sprint Boots (already owned): costs 800 souls more, not 1,600.
items.why: imminent: Spirit Lifesteal completes 4.8k vitality in 1600 souls (~1.6 min), 1 purchases

items.name: Spirit Lifesteal
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k vitality tier (3,200 to 4,800 invested): bonus 20 to 38 vitality bonus.

items.name: Burst Fire
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k weapon tier (2,400 to 4,800 invested): bonus 15 to 46% weapon damage. Upgrade of Rapid Rounds (already owned): costs 2,400 souls more, not 3,200.

items.name: Close Quarters
items.caption: Builds toward the 6.4k weapon tier, which Point Blank completes 2,400 souls on.
items.why: imminent: Point Blank completes 6.4k weapon in 2400 souls (~2.4 min), 1 purchases

items.name: Point Blank
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes weapon from 5,600 to 8,000 invested, crossing the 6.4k, 8k tiers: bonus 46 to 62% weapon damage.

items.name: Mercurial Magnum
items.caption: Imbued on Screwjab Dagger: the imbue charges up over 14s; the charged use reloads the clip and gives 22% fire rate for 12s. Takes spirit from 4,800 to 9,600 invested, crossing the 6.4k, 8k tiers: bonus 38 to 52 spirit power. Upgrade of Quicksilver Reload (already owned): costs 4,800 souls more, not 6,400.

items.name: Leech
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 4,800 to 8,000 invested, crossing the 6.4k, 8k tiers: bonus 38 to 46 vitality bonus.

sections.label: Late game
sections.desc: Souls 25,600-56,000 (levels 28-36). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Lethal Venom T3, Petrifying Bola T3. Your biggest single spirit hit (Lethal Venom, venom max damage) grows from 522 to 683.

items.name: Boundless Spirit
items.caption: +30 spirit adds about 83.7 to Lethal Venom's venom max damage (2.79x scaling), your steepest spirit scaling. Takes spirit from 9,600 to 14,400 invested: bonus 52 to 59 spirit power. Upgrade of Improved Spirit (already owned): costs 4,800 souls more, not 6,400.

items.name: Spiritual Overflow
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes weapon from 8,000 to 14,400 invested: bonus 62 to 74% weapon damage.

items.name: Frenzy
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes weapon from 14,400 to 20,800 invested: bonus 74 to 86% weapon damage.

items.name: Ricochet
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes weapon from 20,800 to 27,200 invested: bonus 86 to 100% weapon damage.

items.name: Unstoppable
items.caption: A stun cancels your Slither (movement). Activate this before the stun lands (it cannot be used while stunned): 5.5s immune to stun, silence, sleep, root and disarm, 60s cooldown. Takes vitality from 8,000 to 14,400 invested: bonus 46 to 50 vitality bonus.
items.legacy_note: It can't be used while stunned, so pop it before you slide in.

sections.label: Situational counters
sections.legacy_desc: Dying after Spirit Lifesteal? Buy what is killing you, cheapest first. Not dying? Skip. Sell Bullet Lifesteal.
sections.desc: Dying after Spirit Lifesteal? Buy what is killing you, cheapest first. Not dying? Skip. Sell Bullet Lifesteal.

items.name: Spirit Resilience
items.caption: Spirit resist 30, plus 15 more below 50% health: buy it when enemy spirit damage is what kills you.
items.legacy_note: Their spirit damage keeps hitting you.

items.name: Dispel Magic
items.caption: Purges non-ultimate debuffs (silence, slow, disarm) and heals 250, but cannot be used while stunned or asleep, so it answers a hex or silence and not a stun already on you.
items.legacy_note: Slows and hexes stop you sliding in.

items.name: Counterspell
items.caption: Your next parry blocks an enemy ability's damage and effects (0.8s window, 23s cooldown), so it only answers an ability you can see coming.
items.legacy_note: A big ult or stun you can see coming.

items.name: Metal Skin
items.caption: Immune to bullets only, for 5s on a 24s cooldown, at 1.5m/s slower: buy it against one gun carry, not against ability damage.
items.legacy_note: Their gun carry wins the close-range fight.

items.name: Plated Armor
items.caption: Passive: 30% chance to deflect a bullet and 50% to block its on-hit effects; it helps against several gun heroes at once where a timed bullet immunity covers only one.
items.legacy_note: Most of their damage is gun.

items.name: Silencer
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes weapon from 27,200 to 32,000 invested: bonus 100 to 115% weapon damage.

items.name: Arctic Blast
items.caption: Same-slot upgrade of Cold Front for 4,800 more souls: damage 95 to 175; tech resist 6 to 10..

items.name: Vampiric Burst
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 14,400 to 20,800 invested: bonus 50 to 54 vitality bonus.

items.name: Divine Barrier
items.caption: Cast on yourself or an ally: removes non-stun debuffs and gives a 600 barrier for 6s, 45s cooldown (halved when cast on an ally), so it covers debuffs and burst damage but not a stun.
items.legacy_note: If you bought Dispel Magic, sell it for this.

items.name: Juggernaut
items.caption: Same-slot upgrade of Enduring Speed for 4,800 more souls: fire rate slow 0 to 40; slow resistance percent 25 to 50..
